subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in direct speech.

Lata told me to give her a glass of water.

options.text: Lata said, “Give her a glass of water.”
Lata said to me, “Give me a glass of water.”
Lata said, “Can you give her a glass of water.”
Lata asked me, “Give me a glass of water.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech. There is only one subject. 'that' is also not present as a linker.
 
• **'to' **is used as a linker. It can be said that the sentence is an imperative sentence.
 
• The process of changing an indirect speech to direct speech is as follows:
